propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso only on binding_store, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and siblings to binding_lifecycle which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, so the patch no longer reaches those operations.

The integration test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but its ability to catch regressions where moved operations stamp updated_at unconditionally is silently weakened.

clear_absent is structurally unreachable on a healthy in-window idempotency pass because its call sites are both gated on out-of-window-but-alive keys, making AC#2 mutation-RED verification impossible within the test's fixture constraints.
The no-stamp contract for clear_absent is pinned at unit tier via test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence, containing the coverage gap introduced by the module extraction.
